reply: Thank you for explaining that an ATM debited $390.00 from your card but dispensed no cash, and that the ATM owner and the card provider each refer you to the other. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the ATM receipt or error details and your dispute records, and ask in writing for the ATM's transaction log to be reviewed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you returned an unopened product after a long delay in getting a shipping label, and that you are still waiting for your refund. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the return tracking number, the photos you sent and your messages with the seller, and include them in a written dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two ATM attempts dispensed no cash, but your account was debited $400.00 plus a fee. We understand your concern, especially with your tax refund on the card. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the ATM location, time and any receipts, and send a written dispute for the amount debited. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that four prepaid accounts in your household were closed because of a returned charge, and that you were not told the balances or details. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please send a written request for the balance of each account, the reason for closure and how the funds will be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $200.00 gift card from work returns a system error, and that the problem has not been fixed after several months. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the card and notes of each call, and ask in writing for the balance and a replacement card if the error cannot be fixed. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your claim was split into two, and that the $11,000.00 part was denied while the $510.00 part received a temporary credit. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask in writing for the reasons each part was handled differently and the documents used, and keep your claim numbers. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your replacement benefits card was taken from your mailbox and used while you were unable to access it, and that you have not been reimbursed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep records showing where you were at the time and any claim numbers, and ask in writing for the status of your claim. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $50.00 gift card shows a balance by phone but is always declined, and that the registration website does not work. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the card and its packaging, and ask in writing how to register it or receive a replacement. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one of your two fraud claims on your benefits card was decided in your favor, while the other was never received and later denied when resubmitted. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please ask in writing for the reasons for the denial, and keep copies of both claims. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you cannot withdraw $50.00 from your account or close it, even though you have already verified your identity. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please ask in writing why further verification is needed and how the balance can be returned to you, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your dispute has been open for over three years and that the records you received show many transactions debited twice. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please mark each duplicate on the records you received, and send them in writing with your police report. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that someone changed the linked bank account on your card and transferred $7,000.00 out, and that your claim was denied as authorized. We understand how serious this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please keep your police report and fraud reports, and ask in writing for the evidence used to decide your claim, including the account change. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that several purchases were made on your card while you waited to lock it, and that you were given the wrong email for your dispute forms. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep proof of when you first called and when you sent the forms, and ask in writing for confirmation they were received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your two $500.00 gift cards have not worked, and that the time for the investigation keeps changing. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep your case number and copies of the documents you submitted, and ask in writing for a firm date for a decision. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card was stolen, that the replacement never arrived, and that you want your remaining balance returned and the accounts closed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the account services team. Please send a written request for the balance to be returned and both accounts closed, and keep a copy. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $1,600.00 bill pay check to your landlord was returned as refer to maker, and that it has not been reissued or refunded. We understand how stressful this is with your rent. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the payments team. Please keep the check details and your landlord's bank notice, and ask in writing for the funds to be returned. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your prepaid card is declined by every online retailer even though the full balance is available. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the prepaid card team. Some online merchants decline prepaid cards without a registered address, so please register the card if possible and ask in writing why it is declined. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the gift cards you received as a bonus are declined by merchants, even though each still shows a $500.00 balance. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the gift card team. Please keep the cards and the dates of each declined attempt, and ask in writing for the reason and how the balances can be used. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have not been able to access your student loan account online for four months, even after following every step you were given. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep screenshots of the error message, and ask in writing for your account to be checked so you can access it online. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your consolidation application was accepted but the new loan has still not been funded. We understand why timing matters to you. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep the acceptance notice and your application confirmation, and ask in writing for the funding date and any steps still pending. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your student loan was reported 90 days late while it was being transferred, and that the payment you were offered was not affordable. We understand the effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your payment and forbearance records, and dispute the late entry with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you and your mother were misled about income-driven repayment and about releasing her as co-signer. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the co-signer release requirements and your repayment history, and keep any notes of what you were told. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan was reported 90 days late after your deferment ended, raising your insurance costs, and that your letter has not been answered. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep a copy of your letter, and dispute any inaccurate entries with the credit reporting companies as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you asked many times for a discharge application related to your school's misconduct and only recently found out the form existed. We understand your frustration after years of payments. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please complete and send the form with your supporting documents, and keep proof of delivery. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are part of a group settlement for borrower defense and have not received information about the amounts you paid or any refund. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep your settlement notices and payment records, and ask in writing for a full payment history and the status of your discharge. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a forbearance month is affecting your PSLF count, and that you were asked for your full Social Security number to discuss it. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please contact your servicer only through official channels, and ask in writing for the forbearance record and its effect on your count. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that, as co-signer on your daughter's loan, you receive calls, texts and emails many times a day. We understand how disruptive this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a log of each contact, and send a written request stating how and when you want to be contacted. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your joint student loan was forgiven, but you have received conflicting answers about separating it and bills still arrive at your address. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please keep copies of the separation paperwork you sent, and ask in writing for its status. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your school pressed students into private loans, that your federal loans were discharged after the school closed, and that your private loan discharge request was denied. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons for the decision and whether you can appeal. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that interest appears to be accruing on your loans during forbearance, even though you were enrolled in the SAVE plan. We understand your confusion. Your complaint has been logged for review by the student loan servicing team. Please ask in writing for a detailed explanation of how interest is being charged during this period, and keep your statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
